Primary technical report: Israel National Digital Agency (INDA), govextra.gov.il, published Nov 2025 and re-amplified by a July 2026 reporting wave (TechTimes, GBHackers, CyberSecurityNews, securityonline, 2026-07-20/22). TAMECAT is a fileless, modular PowerShell backdoor - prioritise behaviour (search-ms/WebDAV delivery, in-memory loader, Cloudflare Workers / Telegram / Discord / Firebase C2, browser and Outlook theft) over any single indicator. No CVE is associated with this case.
